scope: Restore Publish 14 faction-point recruiter categories, rank-scaled standing capacity, transactional reward delivery, and hireling lifecycle while retiring the reachable NGE global credit-priced GCW catalog, class/level gates, dynamic population pricing, recruiter vendor surface, and camp field requisition surface.

findings: Publish 14 recruiters expose faction-specific furniture, weapon/armor, installation, uniform, hireling, and schematic categories; purchases consume faction standing rather than credits and leave the 200-point membership reserve.
Aligned standing capacity scales with the authored rank cost at twenty times the current rank cost, with a 1000-point floor; unaligned or opposing standing remains capped at 1000.
Installations, uniforms, and hirelings require declared status, Imperial uniforms remain faction-specific, and hirelings are delivered as NPC control devices.
